info.title: VideoGen API
info.description: Programmatically generate images, videos, voiceovers, sound effects, and avatar clips. All tool runs are asynchronous: `POST /v1/tools/...` returns a `toolExecutionId`; poll `GET /v1/tools/executions/{toolExecutionId}` until `status` is `succeeded`, `failed`, or `cancelled`, or subscribe to webhooks. Workflow runs use `workflowRunId` (`vg_work_...`); poll `GET /v1/workflows/runs/{workflowRunId}`. All IDs are prefixed strings (e.g. `vg_tool_...`, `vg_work_...`, `vg_file_...`). Store them as-is and do not parse them.

Each action runs asynchronously as its own remix action; the response returns one remix action id per action in order. post.description: Generate an image from a text prompt, optionally guided by one or more reference images. When reference images are provided, the prompt describes the desired transformation. VideoGen automatically routes each request to the most effective state-of-the-art image model for your prompt, reference images, and quality tier, so you don't pick a model.

request.prompt: A serene mountain landscape at sunrise with vibrant colors and mist
Transform this photo into an oil painting style with warm autumn tones

post.description: Generate a single short video clip (up to 15 seconds) from a text prompt, optionally guided by reference images, videos, and audio. At least one of `prompt`, `imageFileIds`, `videoFileIds`, or `audioFileIds` must be provided. VideoGen automatically routes each request to the most effective state-of-the-art video model for your inputs and settings, so you don't pick a model. This endpoint returns one standalone clip. For longer, higher-quality, professionally edited videos with narration, captions, music, and multiple scenes, use a video workflow such as [Script to video](/workflows) (`POST /v1/workflows/script-to-video`) instead.

request.prompt: A serene mountain landscape at sunrise with a flowing river and birds flying
Apply a cinematic color grade with enhanced contrast and film grain
Create a dynamic video animation from this serene mountain landscape image, adding subtle cloud movements and ambient nature sounds.

bearerAuth.description: API key from [app.videogen.io/developers](https://app.videogen.io/developers). The full key is only shown once when you create it.

PaginationLimit.name: limit
PaginationLimit.description: Maximum number of items to return in the page. Defaults to 50; capped at 200. See [Pagination](/pagination).

PaginationCursor.name: cursor
PaginationCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as `nextCursor` by the previous page. Omit on the first request. Cursors are tied to the endpoint that produced them and must be passed unmodified. See [Pagination](/pagination).

SelfOnlyQuery.name: selfOnly
SelfOnlyQuery.description: When true, returns only items created by the API key's owner. When false (default), returns all items accessible to the team.

IncludeUiProjectsQuery.name: includeUiProjects
IncludeUiProjectsQuery.description: When true, includes dashboard-created projects in addition to API-created projects. When false (default), returns only API-created projects.

IncludeDeprecatedVoicesQuery.name: includeDeprecatedVoices
IncludeDeprecatedVoicesQuery.description: When true, includes voices that are deprecated but still callable. Defaults to false.

AvatarPresenterReferenceVoiceIdQuery.name: voiceId
AvatarPresenterReferenceVoiceIdQuery.description: Optional reference voice id from `GET /v1/resources/tts-voices` (e.g. `vg_voic_...`). When provided, avatar presenters are returned sorted by best match for that voice (best first). Omit to return presenters in the default catalogue order.

EntityTypeQuery.name: entityType
EntityTypeQuery.description: When provided, returns only entities of this type. Omit to return all entities.

WorkflowRunIdPath.name: workflowRunId
WorkflowRunIdPath.description: The workflow run id returned when the workflow was started.

ToolExecutionIdPath.name: toolExecutionId
ToolExecutionIdPath.description: The tool execution id returned when the tool was started.

WebhookEndpointIdPath.name: endpointId
WebhookEndpointIdPath.description: The webhook endpoint id (e.g. `ep_...`) returned by `POST /v1/webhooks/endpoints`.

StorageFile.description: Metadata for a generated file. Obtain ids from tool results or `GET /v1/files`.

type.description: File type. Null when the file is still being processed and the type has not yet been determined.

scope.description:
File scope.

- `GLOBAL`: user-uploaded or standalone generated files that persist indefinitely.
- `PROJECT`: project-specific files (e.g. text-to-speech clips in a generated project).
- `EXPORT`: project exports.
- `TEMPORARY`: short-lived files guaranteed to be available for 24 hours, after which they may be archived at any time. Not analyzed (no description, transcript, or embedding).
- `ENTITY`: files attached to a reusable entity (e.g. a voice sample for an actor), shared across your team.

durationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds for video and audio files. Null for images.

transcript.description: Transcript text for video and audio files, when available. Null for images or when no transcript has been generated.

thumbnailSource.description: Thumbnail image source. Populated after hydration.

previewSource.description: Preview rendition source (720p for video, resized for images). Populated after hydration.

downloadSource.description: Highest-quality downloadable rendition. Populated after hydration.

hlsSource.description: Private HLS streaming source. Populated for video and audio files once streaming renditions are ready. Uses a signed token; treat like other signed sources.

isPublicPreviewEnabled.description: Whether public preview is enabled for this file. When true, `staticPublicPreviewSource` is populated for all file types. For video and audio, `publicHlsUrl` and `publicPlaybackId` are also populated once embed streaming is ready.

staticPublicPreviewSource.description: Permanent public URL for the file's highest-quality rendition. Populated when `isPublicPreviewEnabled` is true. Does not expire (`expiresAt` is null). Use for direct links to images, downloads, or any file type. For embedded video or audio players, prefer `publicPlaybackId`.

publicHlsUrl.description: Public HLS streaming URL for video and audio. Only present when `isPublicPreviewEnabled` is true and embed streaming is ready. Prefer `publicPlaybackId` with `@videogen/player` for embeds.

publicPlaybackId.description: Encoded public playback id (e.g. `vg_play_...`) for video and audio embeds. Pass this to `@videogen/player` or `@videogen/player-react`. Only present when `isPublicPreviewEnabled` is true and embed streaming is ready. For a permanent direct file URL (any type), use `staticPublicPreviewSource` instead.

sourceToolType.description: Tool type that generated this file (e.g. `GENERATE_IMAGE`, `TEXT_TO_SPEECH`). Only present when the file was created by a tool execution.

sourceToolExecutionId.description: Execution id of the tool call that generated this file (e.g. `vg_tool_...`). Only present when the file was created by a tool execution.

fileAnalysisMetadata.description: Background analysis state for the file (used to populate `description`, `transcript`, `durationSeconds`, and the search embedding). Omitted when the file was returned via a path that does not check analysis progress (e.g. tool-result inline files and webhook payloads).

FileAnalysisMetadata.description: Background analysis state for a file. Background analysis populates `description`, `transcript`, `durationSeconds`, and the search embedding after a file is uploaded or generated; this object lets you render a progress indicator while it runs (and skip rendering once it's done).

analysisLoadingState.description:
Coarse-grained analysis state.

- `UNATTEMPTED`: analysis has not started yet.
- `LOADING`: analysis is in progress.
- `FULFILLED`: analysis completed successfully. `description`, `transcript`, and `durationSeconds` are now populated where applicable for the file's type.
- `REJECTED`: analysis failed permanently and will not be retried.

analysisProgressPercentage.description: Progress in `[0, 100]`. Always `100` when `analysisLoadingState` is `FULFILLED`. Otherwise the most recent in-flight progress reported by the analysis task (or `0` if no progress has been reported yet).

analysisAttemptIndex.description: Zero-based index of the current analysis task attempt. Only present while analysis is still loading (`UNATTEMPTED` or `LOADING`); omitted once analysis reaches a terminal state.

FileSource.description: A rendition source for a file (e.g. thumbnail, preview, download). Contains a signed URL and metadata.

status.description: `pending`: asset is still processing or has not been hydrated yet. `ready`: signed URL is available. `failed`: rendition generation failed. `skipped`: rendition does not apply to this file type (e.g. thumbnail for audio).

url.description: Signed URL. Present when status is `ready` and file has been recently hydrated. If missing, call the hydrate endpoint.

expiresAt.description: Seconds since epoch (Unix timestamp) when the signed URL expires.

width.description: Rendition width in pixels, when known.

height.description: Rendition height in pixels, when known.

fileBytes.description: File size in bytes, when known.

query.description: Natural-language search query. The text is embedded and compared against file description vectors using cosine similarity.

numResults.description: Number of results to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

selfOnly.description: When true, only files created by the calling API key's user are returned. When false (default), all files accessible to the team are included.

similarity.description: Cosine similarity between the query embedding and the file description embedding. Ranges from 0 (no match) to 1 (identical). Values above 0.7 typically indicate strong relevance.

type.description: The type of file to upload. Optional; when omitted, the type is inferred after upload processing completes.

displayName.description: Display name for the uploaded file.

isTemporary.description: When true, the file is temporary. Temporary files are guaranteed to be available for 24 hours, after which they may be archived at any time. Temporary files are not analyzed (no description, transcript, or embedding will be generated), so they will not appear in search results. Defaults to false.

fileId.description: The file id to use in subsequent API calls (e.g. `vg_file_...`).

uploadUrl.description: Pre-signed URL. PUT the raw file bytes to this URL to complete the upload.

hasMore.description: When true, there are more files available. Pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` query param to fetch the next page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor to fetch the next page. `null` when `hasMore` is false.

description.description: Optional description of the reference. Empty string when not set.

isDefault.description: When true, this is the entity's primary reference (used for its thumbnail).

voiceDisplayName.description: Display name of the actor's voice when one is configured. Null otherwise.

hasVoice.description: True when the actor has a configured voice.

hasAvatarPresenter.description: True when the actor has a configured avatar presenter.

description.description: Optional description. Empty string when not set.

actorConfig.description: Voice and presenter summary for ACTOR entities. Null for VISUAL_STYLE entities.

references.description: Reference images attached to the entity.

updatedAt.description: When the entity was last updated (ISO 8601).

hasMore.description: When true, there are more entities available. Pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` query param to fetch the next page.

entityType.description: ACTOR features a consistent character; PRODUCT features a consistent product or object; VISUAL_STYLE guides the look of generated images.

name.description: New display name. Omit to leave unchanged.

description.description: New description. Omit to leave unchanged.

isDefault.description: When true, make this the entity's primary reference (used for its thumbnail).

previewVideoUrl.description: Short preview clip of the presenter speaking.

apiKeyId.description: The id of the API key used to authenticate this request.

teamId.description: The id of the team the API key belongs to.

Language.description: A language a project can be translated into.

WatermarkMode.description: Controls whether the VideoGen watermark is applied to the output. `AUTO` applies the watermark unless you have the Production API add-on. `VIDEO_GEN` always applies it. `NONE` removes the watermark — requires the Production API add-on; returns an error if you don't have it.

AspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio as a width:height pair (e.g. 16 and 9 for 16:9). Not pixel dimensions.

prompt.example: Write a 30-second upbeat video script about why the sky is blue.
prompt.description: The instruction or content to generate text from.

system.description: Optional system instructions that steer the model's role, tone, and constraints.

quality.description: Generation quality tier. `LOW` is fastest and cheapest; `STANDARD` balances quality and cost; `HIGH` is higher quality; `MAX` is highest quality. Defaults to `STANDARD`.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Higher values produce more varied output. Defaults to the model's default.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. Defaults to 512.

prompt.example: A serene Japanese garden with cherry blossoms at golden hour
prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate. When reference images are provided, the prompt describes the desired transformation.

imageFileIds.description: Optional file ids of reference images (e.g. `["vg_file_..."]`). Upload files first via `POST /v1/files/upload`, then pass the returned ids here. Maximum 4 images. When provided, the model uses these as guidance for generation.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio for the generated image. Defaults to 16:9 when omitted.

quality.description: Image generation quality tier. LOW is fastest; HIGH is slowest and highest quality.

numResults.description: Number of output results to generate. Defaults to 1.

isOutputTemporary.description: When true, generated files are temporary. Temporary files are guaranteed to be available for 24 hours, after which they may be archived at any time. Temporary files are not analyzed (no description, transcript, or embedding will be generated), so they will not appear in search results. Defaults to false.

GenerateVideoClipRequest.description: At least one of `prompt`, `imageFileIds`, `videoFileIds`, or `audioFileIds` must be provided.

prompt.example: A golden retriever running through a sunlit meadow in slow motion, cinematic
prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video to generate. Optional when reference media is provided. Describe the video in plain language; any reference media you provide is incorporated automatically.

imageFileIds.description: Optional file ids of reference images (e.g. `["vg_file_..."]`). Upload files first via `POST /v1/files/upload`, then pass the returned ids here. When provided, the images are animated or used as visual guidance for the generated video.

videoFileIds.description: Optional file ids of reference videos (e.g. `["vg_file_..."]`). Upload files first via `POST /v1/files/upload`, then pass the returned ids here. They are used as motion or style guidance for the generated video.

audioFileIds.description: Optional file ids of reference audio clips (e.g. `["vg_file_..."]`) used for native lip-sync and soundtrack. Upload files first via `POST /v1/files/upload`, then pass the returned ids here.

generateAudio.description: When true, the generated video is guaranteed to include audio. When false, audio may still be present. Defaults to false.

durationSeconds.description: Desired clip length in seconds. A whole number between 1 and 15. Defaults to 6 when omitted. This endpoint produces a single short clip. For longer, multi-scene, professionally edited videos, use a video workflow such as `POST /v1/workflows/script-to-video`.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio for the generated video. Defaults to 16:9 when omitted.

quality.description: Video generation quality tier. STANDARD is fastest; HIGH is slowest and highest quality.

voiceId.description: Voice id from `GET /v1/resources/tts-voices`. Only voices with `supportsDirectToolExecution` set to true are accepted.

autoExpandPronunciationReplacements.description: When true, automatically expands numbers, symbols, acronyms, and other non-word tokens into their spoken forms before synthesis so the voice pronounces them correctly (e.g. `$100` → `one hundred dollars`, `NASA` → `nasa`, `3rd` → `third`). Defaults to false when omitted.

voiceSpeed.description: Speech rate multiplier. Defaults to the voice's default speed.

Temporary files are not analyzed (no description, transcript, or embedding will be generated), so they will not appear in search results. Defaults to false.

prompt.description: A text description of the sound effect to generate.

durationSeconds.description: Desired length of the sound effect in seconds, between 1 and 30. Defaults to about 10 seconds when omitted.

isOutputTemporary.description: When true, generated files are temporary. Temporary files are guaranteed to be available for 24 hours, after which they may be archived at any time. Temporary files are not analyzed (no description, transcript, or embedding will be generated), so they will not appear in search results. Defaults to false.

imageStorageFileId.description: File id of the source image (e.g. `vg_file_...`). Upload a file first via `POST /v1/files/upload`, then pass the returned id here.

videoStorageFileId.description: File id of the source video (e.g. `vg_file_...`). Upload a file first via `POST /v1/files/upload`, then pass the returned id here.

StartToolExecutionResponse.description: Returned when a tool execution is started. Use `toolExecutionId` to poll for results or cancel.

ExecutedToolStatus.description: `pending` and `running` are in-progress; `succeeded`, `failed`, and `cancelled` are terminal.

ToolSuccessResult.description: Result for a single generated file. Present when `status` is `succeeded`.

fileId.description: File id for the generated asset.

file.description: Hydrated file metadata with signed download URLs. Populated when returned from a webhook or after hydration.

code.description: Machine-readable error code in snake_case (e.g. `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_credits`). Not always present.

requirement.description: What is needed to resolve the error. Present when the error can be fixed by fulfilling a specific requirement (e.g. purchasing an add-on).

internalErrorCode.description: Opaque internal error code for debugging. Include this when contacting support.

toolExecutionId.description: Execution id matching the original request.

progressPercentage.description: Completion progress for the current attempt (0-100). Always `100` when `status` is `succeeded`.

attemptIndex.description: Zero-based index of the current or most recent execution attempt.

results.description: One entry per generated result. Present when `status` is `succeeded`.

ToolExecutionListResponse.description: Paginated list of API-started tool executions, most recently created first.

hasMore.description: When true, there are more executions available. Pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` query param to fetch the next page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor to fetch the next page. `null` when `hasMore` is false.

ToolExecutionWebhookEventName.description: Webhook event types for tool execution lifecycle.

WorkflowRunWebhookEventName.description: Lifecycle events emitted for workflow runs started via the developer API.

FileUploadWebhookEventName.description: Webhook event types for file upload lifecycle. Only fired for files uploaded via the API (not the VideoGen UI).

WebhookEventName.description: All webhook event types. Use when creating or listing webhook endpoints.

VisualPacing.description: How quickly visuals change. FAST shows more, shorter shots; SLOW holds each visual longer. Defaults to MEDIUM.

WorkflowVisualStyle.description: Visual treatment for the generated b-roll.

type.description: STOCK pulls stock footage and images. AI_IMAGE generates a styled image for each section. ENTITY generates images that match a visual-style entity's reference images for a consistent look.

aiStyle.description: Only applies when type is AI_IMAGE. A free-form description of the look applied to every generated image (e.g. `vintage 1970s film photography, warm grain`). See the AI styles reference for example descriptions of the app's default styles. Required when type is AI_IMAGE.

entityId.description: Only applies when type is ENTITY. The id of a VISUAL_STYLE entity (e.g. `vg_enti_...`) whose reference images guide every generated image. Required when type is ENTITY.

restyleFeaturedBRollWithAiStyle.description: Only applies when type is AI_IMAGE. When true, featured b-roll images you provide are re-rendered in the chosen style so they match the generated look (no effect on featured b-roll videos). Defaults to true.

WorkflowRgbColor.description: An RGB color. Each channel is an integer from 0 to 255.

type.description: RECT draws one rectangle behind the whole line; WRAPPED hugs the text; WORD_BY_WORD draws a box per word.

borderRadiusProportion.description: Corner rounding as a proportion of the background height (0 = square corners).

WorkflowCaptionStyle.description: Caption styling. Any omitted field falls back to the VideoGen default caption style. Provide an empty object (`{}`) to keep the default style but ensure captions are shown. Pass `null` for the whole `captionStyle` field to hide captions entirely.

verticalAlignment.description: Vertical position of the caption block in the frame.

strokeColor.description: Outline color around glyphs, or null for no outline.

backgroundStyle.description: Background drawn behind the text, or null for no background.

spokenTextColor.description: Color applied to the currently spoken word for karaoke-style highlighting, or null to keep the base text color.

spokenTextStrokeColor.description: Outline color applied to the currently spoken word, or null.

persistSpokenTextColor.description: When true, a word keeps the spoken-text color after it has been spoken instead of reverting.

RemixActionType.description: The kind of edit a remix action applies.

RemixTransitionStyle.description: A transition applied at a boundary. `DYNAMIC` auto-varies the style across boundaries; `NONE` removes transitions; the rest apply that fixed style everywhere.

RemixActionSetBackgroundMusic.description: Set, replace, or remove the project's background music track.

fileId.description: File id of an uploaded audio file to use as background music (e.g. `vg_file_...`). Upload it first via `POST /v1/files/upload`. Pass `null` to remove the existing background music.

volume.description: Music volume from 0 (silent) to 1 (full). Omit or pass `null` to keep the current volume.

RemixActionSetLogo.description: Set, replace, or remove the logo overlay.

fileId.description: File id of an uploaded image to overlay as a logo (e.g. `vg_file_...`). Upload it first via `POST /v1/files/upload`. Pass `null` to remove the existing logo.

position.description: Position the logo is anchored to. Omit or pass `null` to keep the current position.

sizePercent.description: Logo width as a percentage of the video width. Omit or pass `null` to keep the current size.

RemixActionEnableCaptions.description: Show captions on every captionable section. Optionally override the project caption style.

captionStyle.description: Caption styling to apply. Omit or pass `null` to show captions with the current style. Any provided field overrides that field; omitted fields keep their current value.

RemixActionDisableCaptions.description: Hide captions on every captionable section.

RemixActionAddTransitions.description: Stamp transitions across the project. Not per-boundary: each field you set is applied uniformly to every boundary in that scope, replacing any transition already there. Set the transition between sections, between base-layer assets, or both; omit or pass `null` for a scope to leave its transitions untouched. To change transitions on specific scenes only, use `EDIT_WITH_AGENT` instead.

sectionTransition.description: Transition applied at every boundary between sections, replacing any existing section transitions. Omit or pass `null` to leave section transitions untouched.

assetTransition.description: Transition applied at every boundary between base-layer assets within sections, replacing any existing asset transitions. Omit or pass `null` to leave asset transitions untouched.

RemixActionResizeProject.description: Change the project's output aspect ratio (e.g. to a vertical 9:16 social format). The video is re-flowed to the new ratio.

RemixActionCleanUpTranscript.description: Tighten every transcript in the project by removing silent pauses and/or filler words. Useful for polishing narration captured from raw recordings.

removePauses.description: Remove silent pauses longer than `minPauseSeconds`. Defaults to `true`.

fillerWords.description: Override the filler-word list to remove. Omit or pass `null` to use the built-in defaults.

minPauseSeconds.description: Shortest pause (in seconds) to remove; pauses below this stay. Omit or pass `null` to use the default threshold.

RemixActionConvertImagesToVideos.description: Animate every eligible still image in the project into a short AI video clip (image-to-video), replacing each image in place. Eligible images are non-SVG image assets backed by an uploaded or stock file. Runs asynchronously: one clip is generated per image. If the project has no eligible images, the action is skipped and completes successfully without changing anything (for example, a project whose timeline is already all video clips).

motionPrompt.description: Describe the motion to apply to every image (e.g. "slow cinematic push-in"). Omit or pass `null` for automatic motion.

muteOutputVideos.description: Mute the generated clips and suppress generated background music. Recommended when the clips sit behind a voiceover. Defaults to `true`.

RemixActionRegenerateImages.description: Restyle every eligible still image in the project to a new look (image-to-image), replacing each image in place. Eligible images are non-SVG image assets backed by an uploaded or generated file. Runs asynchronously: one restyled image is generated per eligible image. If the project has no eligible images, the action is skipped and completes successfully without changing anything.

stylePrompt.description: Describe the visual style to apply to every image (e.g. "watercolor painting", "cinematic film still").

modelMode.description: Image generation quality tier. Defaults to `STANDARD`.

RemixActionUpscaleAssets.description: Sharpen every eligible asset in the project up to 4K, replacing each in place. Runs asynchronously: one upscaled asset is generated per eligible asset. If the project has no eligible assets, the action is skipped and completes successfully without changing anything.

includeVideos.description: Also upscale video assets (billed per output second). Defaults to `true`.

includeStockContent.description: Also upscale stock (library) assets, not just uploaded or generated ones. Defaults to `true`.

RemixActionChangeNarrator.description: Re-narrate every AI-voiceover asset in the project with a new voice (and optionally a presenter avatar), replacing each narration in place. Runs asynchronously: text-to-speech is re-fired per asset with the original narration text. If the project has no AI-narrated assets, the action is skipped and completes successfully without changing anything.

voiceId.description: Voice id from `GET /v1/resources/tts-voices` (e.g. `vg_voic_...`) to re-narrate with.

avatarPresenterId.description: Optional avatar presenter id from `GET /v1/resources/avatar-presenters` (e.g. `vg_pres_...`). When set, the narration is delivered by a talking-head presenter avatar. Pass your `voiceId` to that endpoint to list presenters sorted by best match for the voice. Omit or pass `null` for a standard voiceover with no presenter.

voiceSpeed.description: Speech rate multiplier. Omit or pass `null` to keep each asset's current speed.

RemixActionShuffleStockVisuals.description: Replace every stock (library) visual in the project with a fresh alternative from the same search, replacing each in place. Runs asynchronously: each stock asset's original search is re-run, excluding the currently-shown result. If the project has no shuffleable stock visuals, the action is skipped and completes successfully without changing anything.

RemixActionGenerateMusic.description: Generate a background music track from a text prompt and set it as the project's background music, replacing any existing track. Runs asynchronously.

prompt.description: Describe the music to generate (e.g. "upbeat corporate background music with a driving beat").

RemixActionTranslateProject.description: Translate the whole project into another language: every piece of text (title, section names, on-screen text overlays, transcripts, and narration scripts) is translated, and — unless disabled — each AI voiceover is re-narrated in the new language. Runs asynchronously. Requires a Pro subscription. Retrieve the list of supported language codes from `GET /v1/resources/languages`.

languageCode.description: Target language code to translate the project into (e.g. `es`, `fr`, `ja`). Must be one of the codes returned by `GET /v1/resources/languages`.

changeVoice.description: Swap each AI voiceover to a voice that natively matches the target language. Recommended, since keeping the original voice usually produces a foreign accent. Defaults to `true`.

translateImageText.description: Also re-generate every eligible image so that text baked into the image is translated too (image-to-image). Billed per generated image. Defaults to `false`.

RemixActionEditWithAgent.description: Apply an open-ended, natural-language edit to the project. An editing agent interprets the prompt, makes the changes, validates them, and visually checks the result. Well suited to tasks like replacing placeholder copy with your own text.

prompt.description: A natural-language description of the edit to make (e.g. "Replace the headline with 'Summer Sale - 40% off' and update the subtitle to match").

mode.description: Editing strategy. `MINOR_EDIT` (default) makes targeted changes while keeping the structure. `RETHINK` re-storyboards the video: it selects which scenes to keep and their order, then edits each in parallel.

targetDurationSeconds.description: Optional soft ceiling on the rebuilt video's duration, in seconds. Only used when `mode` is `RETHINK`.

RemixAction.description: A single edit applied to a project. Each array entry is exactly one of the action types below, chosen by its `type` field; the variants are mutually-exclusive options, not fields you must all provide. Include only the actions you want.

remixActions.description: Ordered list of edits to apply. Each runs asynchronously as its own remix action.

saveAsNewProject.description: When true, the project is duplicated first and the edits are applied to the copy, leaving the original untouched. The response's `projectId` is the copy. Defaults to false (edits the project in place).

RemixProjectResponse.description: Returned when remix actions are accepted. Poll `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/remix-actions` for status.

projectId.description: Id of the edited project (e.g. `vg_proj_...`; the duplicate when `saveAsNewProject` was true).

projectUrl.description: URL to view the project in the VideoGen app.

remixActionIds.description: Opaque remix action ids (e.g. `vg_rmix_...`), one per requested action in order.

RemixActionStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a remix action.

projectId.description: Id of the project this remix action edits (e.g. `vg_proj_...`).

projectUrl.description: URL to view the project in the VideoGen app.

progressPercentage.description: Completion progress for the current attempt (0-100). Always `100` when `status` is `succeeded`.

attemptIndex.description: Zero-based index of the current or most recent execution attempt.

remixActions.description: Remix actions for the project, most recent first.

script.description: The narration script, used verbatim. This exact text is narrated and turned into a video — it is not rewritten or expanded.

quality.description: Image generation quality tier for AI-generated visuals. LOW is fastest and cheapest; STANDARD balances quality and cost; HIGH is highest quality. Only applies when `visualStyle.type` is AI_IMAGE or ENTITY; STOCK pulls existing footage and is unaffected. Defaults to STANDARD.

language.description: Output language as a BCP-47 code (e.g. `en`, `es`, `fr`). Defaults to English.

voiceId.description: Voice id from `GET /v1/resources/tts-voices` (e.g. `vg_voic_...`). A default voice is used when omitted. Any voice may be used here, including voices where `supportsDirectToolExecution` is false.

voiceSpeed.description: Speech rate multiplier. Defaults to the voice's default speed.

avatarPresenterId.description: Optional avatar presenter id from `GET /v1/resources/avatar-presenters` (e.g. `vg_pres_...`). When set, the narration is delivered by a talking-head presenter avatar. Pass your `voiceId` to that endpoint to list presenters sorted by best match for the voice. Omit for a standard voiceover with no presenter.

featuredBRollFileIds.description: Optional file ids of images or videos to feature as b-roll (e.g. `["vg_file_..."]`). Upload files first via `POST /v1/files/upload`. Only image and video files are accepted.

workflowAgentContext.description: Optional production notes for the AI that builds the video — visual direction that should not appear in the spoken narration (e.g. on-screen code or text to display, specific b-roll to feature, or scene-by-scene staging). Never spoken; keep the narration itself in `script`.

remixActions.description: Optional edits applied to the project after the video is built, in order. Each action runs asynchronously; the response returns one remix action id per action. Recommended for script-to-video: `ENABLE_CAPTIONS` to show and style captions, `CONVERT_IMAGES_TO_VIDEOS` to animate still images into clips, `ADD_TRANSITIONS` to stamp transitions between sections, and `SET_LOGO` to overlay a logo (this workflow has no native caption-style or logo fields). `EDIT_WITH_AGENT` applies open-ended natural-language edits. See the [Remix actions](/remix-actions) guide.

fileId.description: Opaque file id of an uploaded voiceover audio file (e.g. `vg_file_...`). Upload the file first via `POST /v1/files/upload`.

quality.description: Image generation quality tier for AI-generated visuals. LOW is fastest and cheapest; STANDARD balances quality and cost; HIGH is highest quality. Only applies when `visualStyle.type` is AI_IMAGE or ENTITY; STOCK pulls existing footage and is unaffected. Defaults to STANDARD.

language.description: Output language as a BCP-47 code (e.g. `en`, `es`, `fr`). Defaults to English.

captionStyle.description: Caption styling. Omit to use the default style with captions shown. Pass an object to override individual style fields (any omitted field uses the default). Pass `null` to hide captions entirely.

logoFileId.description: Optional file id of an uploaded logo image to overlay on the video (e.g. `vg_file_...`). Upload the image first via `POST /v1/files/upload`. Only image files are accepted.

workflowAgentContext.description: Optional production notes for the AI that builds the video — visual direction for how to illustrate the voiceover (e.g. on-screen code or text to display, specific b-roll to feature, or scene-by-scene staging). Never spoken; does not change the uploaded voiceover audio or its transcript.

remixActions.description: Optional edits applied to the project after the video is built, in order. Each action runs asynchronously; the response returns one remix action id per action. Captions and a logo are set with the `captionStyle` and `logoFileId` request fields above; recommended remix actions here are `CONVERT_IMAGES_TO_VIDEOS` to animate still images into clips, `ADD_TRANSITIONS` to stamp transitions between sections and assets, and `EDIT_WITH_AGENT` for open-ended natural-language edits. See the [Remix actions](/remix-actions) guide.

fileId.description: Opaque file id of an uploaded PDF or PowerPoint file (e.g. `vg_file_...`). Upload the file first via `POST /v1/files/upload`.

slideScripts.description: Optional per-slide narration, in slide order, applied by index: each slide uses its matching entry, and an empty string makes that slide silent. If you provide fewer entries than slides, the remaining slides are silent; extra entries are ignored. Omit this field entirely to narrate each slide from its speaker notes in the uploaded file. To guarantee no narration on any slide, pass an empty array.

language.description: Output language as a BCP-47 code (e.g. `en`, `es`, `fr`). Defaults to English.

voiceId.description: Voice id from `GET /v1/resources/tts-voices` (e.g. `vg_voic_...`). A default voice is used when omitted. Any voice may be used here, including voices where `supportsDirectToolExecution` is false.

voiceSpeed.description: Speech rate multiplier. Defaults to the voice's default speed.

avatarPresenterId.description: Optional avatar presenter id from `GET /v1/resources/avatar-presenters` (e.g. `vg_pres_...`). When set, the narration is delivered by a talking-head presenter avatar. Pass your `voiceId` to that endpoint to list presenters sorted by best match for the voice. Omit for a standard voiceover with no presenter.

captionStyle.description: Caption styling. Omit to use the default style with captions shown. Pass an object to override individual style fields (any omitted field uses the default). Pass `null` to hide captions entirely.

logoFileId.description: Optional file id of an uploaded logo image to overlay on the video (e.g. `vg_file_...`). Upload the image first via `POST /v1/files/upload`. Only image files are accepted.

remixActions.description: Optional edits applied to the project after the video is built, in order. Each action runs asynchronously; the response returns one remix action id per action. Captions and a logo are set with the `captionStyle` and `logoFileId` request fields above; recommended remix actions here are `CONVERT_IMAGES_TO_VIDEOS` to animate still images into clips, `ADD_TRANSITIONS` to stamp transitions between sections and assets, and `EDIT_WITH_AGENT` for open-ended natural-language edits. See the [Remix actions](/remix-actions) guide.

SceneGeneration.description: How a scene is generated. Tagged by `type`: AI_IMAGE produces a still image from the prompt; AI_VIDEO produces a video clip from the prompt.

type.description: AI_IMAGE generates a still image. AI_VIDEO generates a video clip.

aiStyle.description: A free-form description of the look, appended to the scene prompt (e.g. `loose watercolor illustration with visible brushstrokes`). See the AI styles reference for example descriptions of the app's default styles. No extra style is applied when omitted.

GenerateStoryboardScene.description: A single scene in the storyboard. Becomes one section in the final video.

prompt.description: What to generate for this scene.

title.description: Optional section name for this scene. Defaults to a numbered name.

generation.description: Optional per-scene generation override. Falls back to the request-level `defaultGeneration` when omitted.

durationSeconds.description: Optional per-scene duration in seconds. Falls back to `defaultDurationSeconds` when omitted. For AI_VIDEO scenes this must be a whole number between 1 and 15.

actorEntityId.description: Optional id of an ACTOR entity (e.g. `vg_enti_...`) to feature in this scene. The entity's reference images are added so the same character appears in the generated image or video.

visualStyleEntityId.description: Optional id of a VISUAL_STYLE entity (e.g. `vg_enti_...`) whose reference images guide the look of this scene.

voiceoverScript.description: Optional voiceover script for this scene. When provided, text-to-speech audio is generated from this text, then combined with the actor entity's reference image to produce a talking-head avatar video. The TTS voice is sourced from the actor entity's voice configuration.

scenes.description: Ordered list of scenes. Each scene becomes one section in the final video, in this order.

defaultGeneration.description: Default generation applied to scenes that don't set their own `generation`. Defaults to AI_IMAGE with no extra style.

defaultDurationSeconds.description: Default per-scene duration in seconds for scenes that don't set their own `durationSeconds`. Defaults to 5. For AI_VIDEO scenes this must be a whole number between 1 and 15.

quality.description: Generation quality tier for every scene. LOW is fastest and cheapest; STANDARD balances quality and cost; HIGH is highest quality. Defaults to STANDARD. LOW is not supported for AI_VIDEO scenes: the request is rejected if any scene is generated as a video at LOW quality.

workflowAgentContext.description: Optional storyboard-wide production notes for the AI that builds the video (e.g. recurring characters or props, a consistent setting, or overall staging guidance). Applies across every scene; per-scene direction goes in each scene's `prompt`.

remixActions.description: Optional edits applied to the project after the video is built, in order. Each action runs asynchronously; the response returns one remix action id per action. `ENABLE_CAPTIONS` shows and styles captions, `SET_BACKGROUND_MUSIC` sets a music track, `ADD_TRANSITIONS` stamps transitions between scenes, and `SET_LOGO` overlays a logo. `EDIT_WITH_AGENT` applies open-ended natural-language edits. See the [Remix actions](/remix-actions) guide.

StartWorkflowRunResponse.description: Returned when a workflow run is accepted. Poll `GET /v1/workflows/runs/{workflowRunId}` or subscribe to webhooks for completion.

projectId.description: Id of the project created for this workflow run (e.g. `vg_proj_...`).

projectUrl.description: URL to view the project in the VideoGen app.

remixActionIds.description: Opaque remix action ids (e.g. `vg_rmix_...`), one per `remixActions` entry in request order. Empty when no remix actions were requested. Each runs after the video is built; poll `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/remix-actions`.

WorkflowRunStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a workflow run.

progressPercentage.description: Completion progress for the current attempt (0-100). Always `100` when `status` is `succeeded`.

attemptIndex.description: Zero-based index of the current or most recent execution attempt.

projectId.description: Id of the project created for this workflow run (e.g. `vg_proj_...`).

projectUrl.description: URL to view the project in the VideoGen app.

WorkflowRunListResponse.description: Paginated list of API-started workflow runs, most recently created first.

hasMore.description: When true, there are more runs available. Pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` query param to fetch the next page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor to fetch the next page. `null` when `hasMore` is false.

WorkflowRunWebhookPayload.description: Body POSTed to a registered webhook endpoint when a workflow run reaches a terminal state.

workflowRunId.description: Opaque workflow run id matching the original request.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which VideoGen observed the terminal state.

projectId.description: Id of the project created for this workflow run (e.g. `vg_proj_...`).

projectUrl.description: URL to view the project in the VideoGen app.

ListProjectsResponse.description: Paginated list of projects, most recently updated first. By default only API-created projects are included; pass `includeUiProjects=true` on the request to also include dashboard-created projects.

hasMore.description: When true, there are more projects available. Pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` query param to fetch the next page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor to fetch the next page. `null` when `hasMore` is false.

ExportProjectQuality.description: Vertical resolution tier for the rendered MP4.

exportId.description: Opaque export id (e.g. `vg_expo_...`). Poll `GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/exports/{exportId}` or subscribe to webhooks for completion.

ProjectExportStatus.description: `pending` and `running` are in-progress; `succeeded` and `failed` are terminal.

exportId.description: Opaque export id (e.g. `vg_expo_...`) matching the original request.

progressPercentage.description: Completion progress for the current attempt (0-100). Always `100` when `status` is `succeeded`.

attemptIndex.description: Zero-based index of the current or most recent export attempt.

downloadUrl.description: Signed MP4 download URL. Present when `status` is `succeeded`.

thumbnailUrl.description: Signed thumbnail URL. Present when `status` is `succeeded` and a thumbnail is available.

url.description: HTTPS URL that will receive webhook POST requests.

ToolExecutionWebhookPayload.description: Delivered to your webhook endpoint when a tool execution reaches a terminal state. The shape mirrors the `ExecutedTool` response with the addition of `event` and `occurredAt`.

toolExecutionId.description: Execution id matching the original request.

occurredAt.description: Seconds since epoch (Unix timestamp) when the execution reached a terminal state.

results.description: One entry per generated result, each with a hydrated `file`. Present only on `tool_execution.succeeded`.

FileUploadWebhookPayload.description: Delivered to your webhook endpoint during the file upload lifecycle. Only sent for files uploaded via the API. The payload always includes a hydrated `file` object with the latest state.

occurredAt.description: Seconds since epoch (Unix timestamp) when the event occurred.

file.description: Hydrated file object with the latest state at the time of the event.

error.description: Error details. Present only on `file.upload.failed` and `file.analysis_failed`.

createdAt.description: Seconds since epoch (Unix timestamp) when the endpoint was created.

signingSecret.description: HMAC secret for verifying [Standard Webhooks](https://www.standardwebhooks.com/) signatures. Only returned once on create; store it securely.

signingSecretLast4.description: Last four characters of the signing secret, for display purposes.

hasMore.description: When true, there are more endpoints available. Pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` query param to fetch the next page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor to fetch the next page. `null` when `hasMore` is false.
